parsed.evidence_quote: CL-MS performed in E. coli detects crosslinks unique to the compact fold of apo-σ70 occurring at stationary growth phase.
CL-MS performed in E. coli detects crosslinks unique to the compact fold of apo-σ70
The cross-linked complex was precipitated by acetone at −80°C... The protein was reconstituted in 15 μL 8 M Urea
trypsin was added at a 1∶50 enzyme to protein ratio. Digestion occurred overnight at 37 °C.
alkylated with 100 mM propionamide for 30 min at room temperature.
reduced with 50 mM DTT ... and then alkylated with 100 mM propionamide
The peptides were further purified and enriched using an in-house packed stage-tips.
